rows.name: Accounts Receivable
rows.description: What customers owe us

rows.name: Provision for Doubtful Debts
rows.description: A credit balance against receivables: what is not expected to be collected

rows.name: Payment Clearing Account
rows.description: Collected but not yet in a bank account

rows.name: Security Deposits
rows.description: Rent, electricity and other deposits paid, recoverable when the arrangement ends

rows.name: Loans & Advances (Asset)
rows.description: Advances to staff and others, recoverable in cash or kind within the year

rows.name: Input CGST (ITC)
rows.description: Central GST paid on purchases, claimable against output tax

rows.name: Input Cess (ITC)
rows.description: Compensation cess paid on purchases; it can only be set off against output cess

rows.name: GST paid on advances
rows.description: GST paid when an advance for services arrived; cleared as the advance is applied to invoices

rows.name: ITC reversed, reclaimable on payment
rows.description: Credit reversed under Rule 37 because a supplier was not paid in 180 days; it comes back as they are paid

rows.name: TDS Receivable
rows.description: Tax customers deducted from our invoices, recoverable from the government

rows.name: TCS Receivable
rows.description: Tax collected at source by our sellers; claimed against our own income tax

rows.name: Capital Work-in-Progress
rows.description: Cost of assets being built or installed, held until they are put to use

rows.name: Accumulated Depreciation
rows.description: Depreciation charged so far; a credit balance that nets against the asset ledgers

rows.name: Asset Disposal Clearing
rows.description: Holds the sale value of an asset sold by invoice until its disposal is posted

rows.name: Investments
rows.description: Shares, bonds, mutual funds and deposits held for more than a year

rows.name: Current Investments
rows.description: Investments to be realised within twelve months

rows.name: Miscellaneous Expenses (Asset)
rows.description: Preliminary and pre-operative expenses not yet written off

rows.name: Branch / Divisions
rows.description: Inter-branch account; its balances across branches net to nil

rows.name: Suspense Account
rows.description: Holds an entry whose right ledger is not yet known. Should be nil before the books are closed

rows.name: Accounts Payable
rows.description: What we owe suppliers

rows.name: Goods received, bill pending
rows.description: The cost of goods received on a goods receipt note until the supplier's bill is entered

rows.name: GST Payable under Reverse Charge
rows.description: GST we owe on purchases where the supplier does not charge it. Paid in cash; input credit cannot settle it

rows.name: TDS Payable
rows.description: Tax withheld from vendors, owed to the government

rows.name: PF Payable
rows.description: Provident fund deducted and contributed, due to EPFO by the 15th

rows.name: ESI Payable
rows.description: ESI deducted and contributed, due to ESIC by the 15th

rows.name: Professional Tax Payable
rows.description: Professional tax deducted from salaries, due to the state

rows.name: Labour Welfare Fund Payable
rows.description: Employee and employer labour welfare fund contributions

rows.name: Unearned Revenue (Retainers)
rows.description: Advances taken for work not yet done

rows.name: Salaries Payable
rows.description: Net salaries for a posted payroll, until they are paid

rows.name: Bank Overdraft / Cash Credit
rows.description: Overdraft and cash-credit limits drawn; repayable on demand

rows.name: Secured Loans
rows.description: Term loans and other borrowings against a charge on assets

rows.name: Unsecured Loans
rows.description: Loans from directors, partners, relatives and others without security

rows.name: Provisions
rows.description: Expenses incurred and not yet billed or paid: audit fee, bonus, gratuity

rows.name: Provision for Income Tax
rows.description: Income tax for the year, net of advance tax once it is set off

rows.name: Deposits Received
rows.description: Security deposits taken from dealers, tenants and customers

rows.name: Drawings
rows.description: What a proprietor or partner takes out of the business; reduces their capital

rows.name: Opening Balance Equity
rows.description: Holds the other side of opening balances until the books are complete

rows.name: Discount Allowed
rows.description: Contra-income: reduces revenue rather than adding an expense

rows.name: Discount Received
rows.description: Cash and trade discounts given to us by suppliers

rows.name: Profit on Sale of Fixed Assets
Foreign Exchange Gain
rows.description: Gains on settling or restating foreign-currency balances

rows.name: Employer PF, ESI and LWF
rows.description: The employer contributions and PF charges on salaries

rows.name: Staff Reimbursements
rows.description: Expenses employees incurred for the business, repaid with salary

rows.name: Gratuity
rows.description: Gratuity paid or provided under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972

rows.name: Rounding Off
rows.description: Absorbs the paisa lost when an invoice total is rounded to the rupee

rows.name: Provision for Doubtful Debts (expense)
rows.description: The charge, or release, as the provision is raised or lowered

rows.name: Interest & Fees on Late Taxes
rows.description: Interest and late fees on TDS, TCS and GST; not deductible for income tax

rows.name: Composition Tax
rows.description: Tax paid on turnover under the composition scheme; it cannot be collected from buyers

rows.name: Depreciation
rows.description: Charged under Schedule II of the Companies Act

rows.name: ITC reversed on exempt supplies
rows.description: The share of common credit that belongs to exempt supplies, reversed under Rules 42 and 43

rows.name: Loss on Sale or Discard of Fixed Assets
Foreign Exchange Loss
rows.description: Losses on settling or restating foreign-currency balances

rows.name: Cash Short & Excess
rows.description: Differences found when cash is counted: a debit is a shortage, a credit an excess
